required_secrets.note: Fine-grained GitHub PAT, READ-ONLY, whose resource owner is the observed account (`data.owner`). Permissions are the union of what github_core's collection manifest declares per source — Metadata + Contents + Actions read; Administration read only if runner nodes are wanted. Minted and verified by github_core's provision-github-pat skill.

description: git-serious — the product composition (plan/product-map.md: a product is an umbrella plugin whose boot record IS what it is). Stands the product up against one GitHub account: installs the substrate (identity_core), the GitHub vocabulary + collector (github_core, account-scoped per req-github-core-org-scope), the admin pages (administrivia), and git-serious itself (the landing page); seeds the GRIFT; then fires the github_core collector to pull the account's CI/CD system onto the grid. DEV-PHASE record: revs are branches while the pieces land (git_serious self-reference and github_core's org-scope branch); the first tagged release pins immutable tags per req-boot-bootstrap-stage0-3. Install order lists substrate before consumers so git-sourced dependency resolution finds them installed.

plugins.note: Package-mode (tap_plugin.administrivia). TAP admin pages + grid landing; seeded in population.
Package-mode (tap_plugin.identity_core). Install-only substrate: the oidc_issuer convergence node github_core mints. No GRIFT seed.

Package-mode (tap_plugin.github_core). The GitHub vocabulary + collector, account-scoped (req-github-core-org-scope). DEV: branch rev until the org-scope work releases; NOT seeded here — its repo landing page is samsite-shaped (/samsite/repo) and git-serious owns its own pages.

Package-mode (tap_plugin.git_serious). The product itself: landing page. Self-reference (req-boot-bootstrap-stage0-3): the carrier this record is fetched FROM and the version it INSTALLS are independent coordinates. DEV: branch rev.

steps.note: git-serious landing page: the account's CI/CD system as a graph.

Pulls the account's repositories, workflows, runs, jobs, runners, apps. DISABLED in the dev record until the account-scoped PAT is placed (the shared envelope is still the samsite repo-list credential) — fire it from the collectors page / run_collector once it is.
